reviewNotesDraft: Lexidraw is a native document and drawing editor. Sign In opens the secure Lexidraw authentication website and returns to the app. Review credentials will be supplied privately in App Store Connect. The seeded review account will contain disposable sample documents and drawings. Account deletion is available in Settings. Listen generates spoken audio from a selected file; it does not record the microphone. Review notes will be updated with the final supported node families and any explicit limitations.

descriptionDraft: Write, sketch and organize your ideas with Lexidraw. Work with documents, drawings and folders on iPhone and iPad, keep your files synchronized with your Lexidraw account, and share them with other people. Format text, edit tables, create drawings, and listen to your documents read aloud. A Lexidraw account and an internet connection are required for synchronization and read-aloud generation.

privacyAudit.finding: Vercel documents anonymous Web Analytics, no stored IP association, and visitor session identifiers discarded after 24 hours. Hosting/security logs are separate. Audit configured events and hosting settings before publishing disclosures.

Apple describes Audio Data as voice recordings and generic free-form text as Other User Content. Lexidraw read-aloud synthesizes audio from document text; it does not capture microphone input. Final classification must reflect the integrated features and stored generated content.

Separate from Vercel Web Analytics, the website proxy writes page/referrer, user agent, IP, city/region/country and a deterministic visitor hash to the Analytics table. No automatic deletion path was found in source. Authentication browser visits use this website. Final disclosures must include this custom collection; Vercel anonymous-analytics documentation does not describe it.

The proxy matcher excludes /api routes. Custom Analytics covers authentication website page visits, not native REST API searches. Separate Vercel Runtime Logs retain request parameters, so main-app Search History is declared for operational App Functionality. The share extension does not issue native searches or open the authentication website.

Runtime log details include User Agent and Search Params, browser requests can be filtered by IP and user agent, and logs have a retention window on all plans. Declare operational IP/user-agent collection for both targets and native GET searches for the main app; this is separate from custom website Analytics.

readAloudConsent.behavior: Permission is requested only before new audio generation; existing audio plays without the prompt. Cancel sends no generation request. Each pending request has a cancellation identity guard. The disclosure names Google/OpenAI and links the privacy policy.
readAloudConsent.validation: Two API regression tests observed red before implementation, then all eight RecordingTests passed. Production simulator app compiled. Fresh review cancellation race fixed with request identity guard.

User-saved web links and external website referrers retained by the website proxy.
IP address, user agent and deterministic visitor hash in website analytics; service security/request logs.

Native search queries use GET parameters. Vercel Runtime Logs retain request Search Params for operational troubleshooting/security; the custom website proxy excludes API routes.
